maxconnections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous PPP connections allowed by the daemon.

logfile.description: Path to a log file (e.g., '/var/log/pppd.log'); leave blank to use syslog.

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (included in log).

dump.description: Dump all configuration options on startup for diagnostics.

require_mschap.description: Require Microsoft CHAP (v1) authentication; insecure but sometimes needed for legacy clients.

require_mschap_v2.description: Require Microsoft CHAP v2 authentication (stronger; recommended over MSCHAP).

allow_pap.description: Allow PAP authentication (unencrypted passwords) — only if absolutely required.

noauth.description: Bypass peer authentication entirely — insecure and only for trusted loopback/test links.

local_ip.description: Static IP address to assign to this system on the PPP link (e.g., '10.0.0.1'); leave blank for dynamic assignment.

remote_ip.description: Static IP address range or single address for the remote peer (e.g., '10.0.0.100-110' or '10.0.0.100').

name.description: Unique identifier for the pool (used in ipparam and scripts).

ip_pools.description: List of named IP pools for dynamic address assignment with per-pool scripts.

lcp_echo_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between LCP echo requests to the peer.

lcp_echo_failure.description: Number of failed echo requests before the link is considered dead.

lcp_max_configure.description: Maximum number of LCP configuration requests before giving up.

no_vj.description: Disable Van Jacobson TCP/IP header compression (recommended for modern links).

no_vjccomp.description: Disable VJ header compression negotiation (part of LCP).

no_comp.description: Disable all PPP compression (preferred for security and predictability).

mppe_required.description: Require Microsoft Point-to-Point Encryption (MPPE) for all sessions.

mppe_40.description: Allow 40-bit MPPE keys (weak; avoid unless legacy client requires).

mppe_128.description: Require 128-bit MPPE keys (strong; recommended when MPPE is enabled).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before the connection is dropped (0 = no timeout).

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size for the PPP interface (e.g., 1492 for PPPoE).

mru.description: Maximum Receive Unit (MRU); usually match MTU.
